title: Sensory and communication support card
summary: Give responders and helpers a concise, consent-based description of how a person communicates and what reduces distress.
content: Safe-use sequence: Record preferred name, communication method, hearing or vision needs, sensory triggers, calming supports, essential devices, medicine plan, contact, and privacy boundary.
